requirements.requirement: The system must include a sponsor_credibility object in each clinical trial evaluation response returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.credibility_score with the value returned from EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-LOGIC-002 without modification.
The system must include sponsor_credibility.sponsor_type in the API response as defined by the schema from EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-SCHEMA-001.
The system must include sponsor_credibility.explanation as a human-readable string explaining the score.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility object is present for every clinical trial in the response payload when sponsor data exists.
The system must serialize sponsor_credibility fields in a format compatible with existing clinical_trials_models.py response models.
The system must not alter or remove existing fields in the evaluate care API response when adding sponsor_credibility.
The system must include sponsor_credibility in the response passed to the chat layer without requiring additional downstream transformation.
The system must return sponsor_credibility.credibility_score as a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must ensure that multiple clinical trials in a single response each contain their own independent sponsor_credibility object.
The system must return a default sponsor_credibility object with sponsor_type='Unknown', credibility_score=0, and a fallback explanation when sponsor metadata is missing.
The system must not fail the entire evaluation response if sponsor credibility logic returns null or raises an error, and must instead provide the fallback sponsor_credibility object.
The system must ensure the API response remains JSON-serializable after inclusion of sponsor_credibility.
The system must include sponsor_credibility in the same structural location as other evaluation measures within the clinical trial response.
